stylingNotes: Sand / light peach (#fcede2-ish, m-bespoke-layout--bg-sand) band with generous top/bottom padding. Compact testimonial: small round portrait top-left, quotation in large body text, short orange rule, bold name "A/Prof Eleanor Drummond" and position line.
variantRationale: Compact testimonial: small round portrait, quotation, short orange rule, bold name + position; no existing quote variant (carousel-gallery quote slides are inside a carousel)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Compact testimonial: round portrait, quotation, short orange rule, bold name and position

contentPattern.summary: A quotation outside an interactive component is a quote block; portrait and attribution belong in it
contentPattern.structure: row 1 = portrait image; row 2 = quotation paragraph(s) without quote marks; row 3 = name (strong) paragraph + position paragraph

blockContent.notes: Quotation text without the typographic quote marks, not a heading; portrait and attribution live inside the block. Name was an H5/cite in source - author as strong text, not a heading.

occurrences.description: Quote: round portrait dr-eleanor-drummond-headshot.jpg (./images/4e355db5319dac057af052d01b51e95d.jpg), quotation "There is a consensus that for the last thirty years...Alzheimer's brain too.", attribution "A/Prof Eleanor Drummond" + "ADP Co-leader, Associate Professor of Neuroscience and Bluesand Senior Research Fellow"

reuseGuidance: Use for one standalone quotation with a person's portrait. Do not add typographic quote marks; the block adds them. Quotes inside carousels belong to the carousel block.
usageDescription: Single testimonial from a researcher or partner, typically in a sand-coloured section (section metadata Style: sand).
